About the job

Larchmont Analytics runs forecasting software for regional utilities. We are hiring a Senior Systems Administrator to look after our Windows estate and the Azure tenant behind it.

What you will do

Patch and monitor Windows Server and Hyper-V hosts.
Run Intune, Entra ID and conditional access.
Own backups and the disaster recovery runbook.

Work Permits

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada.
